mechanism: The CEC wrapper accepts extra physical-model parameters but forwards hard-coded defaults to calcparams_desoto. The saved spy sees default EgRef/dEgdT/irradiance/temperature values rather than the four supplied values. Forwarding the actual arguments restores the wrapper contract.
limitations: The spy assertion directly proves argument values were discarded. It does not measure the size of a downstream physical prediction error; the label describes wrong data flow rather than a missing dependency.
evidence_reason: Read repair, surrounding base source and saved JUnit; verified frozen source/F2P/P2P/hash/image/cleanup evidence with real_evidence().
